digest.component_or_area: enrichment queue and ticket digest event storage and reduction
propositions: Physical deletion of committed queue and digest events causes git rename-detection conflicts during cross-clone merges despite reclaiming zero repository space

Current O(history) file-open cost in queue reduction dominates the enrichment drain gate budget breach (measured 404-692ms vs 20ms budget), while read-only suffix-lazy ordering can reduce opens from 4977 to 1658 per full-store scan

A merge-safe retention scheme must rename events to deterministic source-derived paths with identical content; ad-hoc deletions paired with UUID-named additions inevitably produce rename/rename conflicts
The design bounds queue reads to newest-first suffixes per event type without deletion or compaction events, preserving invariant I1 and ensuring two-clone reconvergence is unaffected
